args.task_description: 实现 integrate-pinned-upstream 功能：Integrate pinned upstream codex-keysmith as optional Coding Tools Setup step 4. Implement real status, preview, install and removal with a user-selected custom instruction Markdown file and --skip-hooks-isolation so existing Codex hooks are preserved. Do not use upstream refusal-override bundled prompt. Step 4 never gates existing ChatGPT sign-in, smoke, install, or MCP setup. Preserve existing global Codex config and user app data; apply changes only from an explicit in-app user action after preview. No silent download/credential reading or app restart. Use existing React/Electron shell, narrow IPC, exact origin and trusted-main-window checks, private errors, focused tests, and installed non-DEV verification. No new worktree, commit, push, or modification to unrelated AO/CPA/Email modules.
